meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about that zero on his phone, in the middle of a class. Who decided, and did anyone hear him first?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. That's procedure 4.2, and I'm writing it down. Now, on what basis is there a zero at all?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
"Like, being stuck." That's a seventeen-year-old put on the spot by his teacher, Hale, not a confession. Show me the note you wrote on November 2.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
People change their minds between an outline and a final draft, Hale. I want the outline and the essay side by side, and your November 2 note, in front of me now. What else do you have?
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

"If it holds up." Whatever happens, this stays off his record and it stays quiet, Hale. I haven't seen a single page yet, so the outline and that note come to me before I agree to anything about Thursday.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Today you acknowledged entering the zero before calling me, and you offered a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing going on Owen's record. Before I agree to Thursday, I want copies of the October 15 outline and your November 2 note, and I want confirmation that this stays off his record and stays quiet. I expect your offer in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position; she agreed to nothing yet and made seeing the documents a condition for Thursday.
What moved her: "I wrote that down the same day", because it was a specific, dated record tied to Owen's own work.
What cost ground: nothing.
Try next time: when you raise the November 2 note and the October 15 outline, put the actual pages in front of her before you make the rewrite offer, because she trusts only documents she can read herself.
